args.subject: Revised promise dates, allocation and origin documents after your 18 September notice
args.body:
Dear Lin Yu-ting,

Thank you for your notice of 18 September. Five open lines are affected, and two of them were already past due on 25 September (marked below).

HPO-26-00486 line 10 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 24 V (HR-51110) · 555 EA · promised 21 September, now 9 November (past due)
HPO-26-00517 line 20 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 5 V (HR-51130) · 810 EA · promised 23 September, now 4 November (past due)
HPO-26-00517 line 10 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 12 V (HR-51120) · 630 EA · promised 30 September, now 11 November
HPO-26-00672 line 10 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 24 V (HR-51110) · 445 EA · promised 20 November, now 8 January
HPO-26-00646 line 10 · Power supply, AC-DC (HR-51310) · 85 EA · promised 23 November, now 4 January

Could you please:
1. Confirm the revised promise dates above, and tell us whether any quantity can ship earlier.
2. Tell us what allocation Halden will receive of HR-51110, HR-51120, HR-51130 and HR-51310, and whether an earlier allocation is possible, as these parts are needed for our October and November builds.
3. Confirm that orders placed by 1 October are accepted at the old 8-week lead time.
4. Send the certificate of origin and the HTS classification you use for HR-51120 and HR-51130 (JPD150-48S12 and JPD60-48S05, which your notice says are made in Dongguan, China), and for HR-51110 and HR-51310.

Please reply as soon as you can.

Nothing in this email accepts the notice or waives any of Halden's rights under the agreement.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
